title: Irish Breakfast Fry-Up
subtitle: Bacon, sausage, black pudding, eggs, and soda bread on one plate.
description: Bacon, sausage, eggs, beans, tomatoes, and toast on a full English-Irish spread. Weekend breakfast when the hall has time to cook everything at once.

steps.title: Cook sausages and pudding
steps.instruction: Brown sausages in a large skillet over medium heat, turning until internal temperature reaches 160°F, about 12 minutes. Add black pudding slices last 4 minutes— they fall apart if overcooked.

steps.title: Fry bacon and tomatoes
steps.instruction: In a second pan, fry back bacon until edges curl and fat renders. Add tomato halves cut-side down and cook until charred. Hold meats warm on a tray covered loosely with foil.

steps.title: Sauté mushrooms
steps.instruction: Sauté mushrooms in butter over high heat without crowding until deeply browned and moisture evaporates. Season with salt and pepper; hold warm.

steps.title: Toast soda bread
steps.instruction: Fry soda bread slices in butter until golden on both sides, about 2 minutes per side. Keep crisp on a rack in a 200°F oven.

steps.title: Fry eggs and plate
steps.instruction: Fry eggs in clean butter over medium until whites are set (165°F) and yolks are runny. Build each plate with sausage, pudding, bacon, tomato, mushrooms, bread, and an egg. Serve immediately.

stationWorkflow: Run two skillets in parallel—one for meats, one for veg and eggs—to hit eight plates together.
Add black pudding last; it crumbles if it sits on high heat too long.
Plate assembly is fastest if all components are lined on a warm tray before eggs fry.
cleanupNotes: Deglaze sausage pans with hot water while warm—pork fat sets hard once cooled.
Wipe black pudding residue immediately; blood sausage stains boards if left to dry.
leftovers: Reheat meats on a sheet pan at 350°F for 8 minutes; fry fresh eggs to order.
Chop leftovers into a bubble-and-squeak-style potato hash for the next breakfast.
imageAlt: Full Irish breakfast fry-up with bacon, sausage, black pudding, and fried eggs
